effects.title: Hello
effects.summary: The smallest effect: soft colour turning slowly in a six-fold mirrored rosette, folded by the symmetry library and coloured in OKLCH, in one fragment pass through the HDR tail. Every later effect starts from this shape.

useCases: The template for new effects; a calm dark hero at a pinch

effects.title: Kaleidoscope
effects.summary: Drifting coloured glass seen through mirrors: two mirrors at an angle (a rosette), or the four mirror shapes that tile the plane (a square, and the 45-45-90, 60-60-60 and 30-60-90 triangles). Every pixel is folded into the mirrors’ fundamental domain and reads the glass there, so the mirrors meet without a seam.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the kaleidoscope; a conic-gradient wedge repeated by rotation for 6 to 12 wedges.
useCases: A hero or section background on a music, festival or art site
